question: Who designed the administrative code to separate revenue administration from judicial administration?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Cornwallis.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** Lord Lytton was the Governor-General** of India from** 1876 to 1880** and is known for his policies of repression and exploitation of Indian people. However, he did not design the administrative code to separate revenue administration from judicial administration.
 
• ** Lord Cornwallis was the Governor-General of India from 1786 to 1793 and is known for his administrative and judicial reforms.**
 
 
• **He designed the administrative code to separate revenue administration from judicial administration in 1793.**
 
 
 
• ** Lord Auckland** was the Governor-General of India from **1836 to 1842 and is known for his policy of annexation of Sindh**.
 
 
• He did not design the administrative code to separate revenue administration from judicial administration.
 
 
 
• ** Warren Hastings was the Governor-General of Bengal from 1772 to 1785** and the **first Governor-General of India from 1774 to 1785**.
 
 
• He introduced several administrative and judicial reforms during his tenure, but he did not design the administrative code to separate revenue administration from judicial administration.
